# Coda — Apply for startup discount

Six months of the Coda Team plan free, plus startup-specific templates; unlimited Coda AI is included only for startups that apply through a Coda partner.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Published acceptance criteria verbatim: "You have a small or big team and you're not using Coda on your own"; "Be a business less than 5 years old"; "Have raised less than $10M USD" (a CEILING, with no floor stated, so funding_required stays unknown); "Your Coda account is using a business domain and not a personal email (gmail.com, hotmail.com, etc)"; "You can provide a company website"; "You don't currently have a paid subscription and have not paid for Coda in the last 30 days." new_customer_only is recorded as false because that last criterion explicitly admits former paying customers after a 30-day gap rather than requiring a brand-new account. Partner route: "Free unlimited Coda AI if you apply through one of our partners" and "All partner-affiliated startups that meet our requirements will be approved (must include proof in application)" — a partner improves the offer and guarantees approval but is not required. NOTE: Coda has rebranded — the page banner reads "Coda is now Superhuman Docs" and the application form URL resolves to docs.superhuman.com; the historic $1,000 startup credit that aggregators still list does not appear anywhere on this page. AUDIT: the application form now redirects cross-domain to superhuman.com, following Coda's acquisition. A cross-brand redirect is the strongest discontinuation signal available without reading the page, so this is no longer treated as active pending a human re-check.
